digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate / LLM agent tool-loop guard
propositions: The completion-verification gate trips RunawayToolLoopError when re-reading memoized evidence files because the guard layer (outermost) observes and counts memo-served repeats as loop evidence before the memo layer can serve them free
The guard's distinct-ratio window fills with cache-hit signatures that cost nothing but still count as loop evidence, causing legitimate verification runs to abort despite the prior memo-layer fix
Memoization and the runaway guard are in layer conflict: lever 2 makes repeats free and harmless; the guard punishes those same repeats as loop symptoms
The solution uses a shared ToolCallLedger to separate observed calls from executed calls, allowing the guard's ratio arm to count only work that misses the memo cache, not cache-served repeats
A served-streak backstop bounds pure cache-served loops (zero execution for a full window) independently from the ratio arm, preventing cache-only spinning while clearing memo hits
